lines:
flowchart TD
  Store[Canonical Adashi Markdown document] --> Full[Full generated Markdown with MCP authoring notice]
  Store --> Short[Bounded architecture shorts with document links]
  Store --> Desktop[Design browser and existing editable Markdown panel]
  Short --> Full
  Full --> Agent[Agent reads local Markdown]
  Agent --> MCP[Retrieve fresh canonical content and save through MCP]
  Desktop --> Shared[Shared guarded storage API]
  MCP --> Shared
  Shared --> Store
  Task[Task and QA specification references] --> Desktop
  Full --> Drift[External file edits are drift and never canonical input]

data.title: Markdown design discovery and editing routes
